foraging.title: Foraging
foraging.intro: Approved sources per role. Each pass compares a source with its previous snapshot; a difference becomes a finding, and a finding becomes a skill candidate through the skill lifecycle.
foraging.selectOrganization: Select an organization to view its foraging sources.
foraging.disabledNote: Periodic foraging is off on this instance, so no pass runs on its own. The registry below is still editable; ask the operator to switch the sweep on.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One row per approved source; a role may have several.
sources.empty: No sources yet. Add the first one above.

findings.title: Latest findings
findings.description: A difference between a source and its previous snapshot. Unverified findings wait for the skill lifecycle; accepted ones carry the candidate reference.
findings.empty: No findings yet. A finding appears when a source differs from its last snapshot.

skillLifecycle.title: Skill lifecycle
skillLifecycle.subtitle: candidate → verified → deprecated, with rollback to the previous verified revision.
skillLifecycle.intro: Candidates reach only the pilot agents; verified skills reach everyone; deprecated reach nobody.

settings.keyboardShortcutsHint: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
settings.backupRetentionHint: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
settings.feedbackSharingHint: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.

settings.dontAllowHint: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
